commands.description: Re-wrap every DEK under the current KEK generation (KEK rotation; never re-encrypts field data)
commands.help: Env provider: set OLD_APP_KEY to the previous key and APP_KEY to the new one, run, then drop OLD_APP_KEY once zero rows remain on the old generation. `node ace tenant:crypto:rekek --json || alert`

flags.name: tenant
flags.description: Rotate a single tenant (uuid); omit to rotate every tenant

flags.name: dryRun
flags.description: Classify and report what would be re-wrapped, writing nothing

commands.description: Crypto-shred a (subject × category): destroy its DEK so all ciphertext under it is irrecoverable (gated by governance)
commands.help: tenant:crypto:shred --tenant <uuid> --subject <id> --category <key> [--dry-run] [--force]. Refused for a legal-obligation category in retention, an absent governance resolver, or an unwired WORM ledger.

flags.name: dryRun
flags.description: Check the governance gate + preconditions and report, destroying nothing

flags.name: force
flags.description: Required for a real shred (it is irreversible; skips the confirmation)
